tool.name: Heatmap.sim
tool.description: Generate a heatmap for pariwise similarity
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$count' count.dat && #if $input.source == 'shared': ln -s '$input.otu' input_otu.dat && #else ln -s '$input.dist' input_dist.dat && #if $input.source == 'column': ln -s '$input.name' input_name.dat && #end if #end if
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #if $input.source == "shared": #silent $mothur_args.append("shared=input_otu.dat") #if $input.label: #silent $mothur_args.append("label=" + str(str($input.label).replace(",","-"))) #end if #if $input.groups: #silent $mothur_args.append("groups=" + str(str($input.groups).replace(",","-"))) #end if #if $input.calc: #silent $mothur_args.append("calc=" + str(str($input.calc).replace(",","-"))) #end if #elif $input.source == "column": #silent $mothur_args.append("column=input_dist.dat") #silent $mothur_args.append("name=input_name.dat") #elif $input.source == "phylip": #silent $mothur_args.append("phylip=input_dist.dat") #end if #if $count: #silent $mothur_args.append("count=count.dat") #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("fontsize=" + str($fontsize))
echo 'heatmap.sim(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.name: calc
param.label: calc - Calculators (Uses defaults if none selected)
param.option: jclass - Community Membership Similarity the traditional Jaccard similarity coefficient based on the observed richness
jest - Community Membership Similarity the Jaccard similarity coefficient based on the Chao1 estimated richnesses
sorclass - Community Membership Similarity the Sorenson similarity coefficient based on the observed richness
sorest - Community Membership Similarity the Sorenson similarity coefficient based on the Chao1 estimated richnesses
braycurtis - Community Structure Similarity the Bray-Curtis similarity coefficient
jabund - Community Structure Similarity the abundance-based Jaccard similarity coefficient
morisitahorn - Community Structure Similarity the Morisita-Horn similarity coefficient
sorabund - Community Structure Similarity the abundance-based Sorenson similarity coefficient
thetan - Community Structure Similarity the Smith theta similarity coefficient
thetayc - Community Structure Similarity the Yue & Clayton theta similarity coefficient

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The heatmap.sim_ command generates a heat map from data provided in either a shared_ file, a phylip_ distance matrix, or a column_ distance matrix and a name_ file. For calc parameter choices see: https://mothur.org/wiki/calculators/
.. _shared: https://mothur.org/wiki/shared_file/ .. _phylip: https://mothur.org/wiki/phylip-formatted_distance_matrix/ .. _column: https://mothur.org/wiki/column-formatted_distance_matrix/ .. _name: https://mothur.org/wiki/name_file/ .. _heatmap.sim: https://mothur.org/wiki/heatmap.sim/
v.1.24.0: Updated to Mothur 1.33, added count parameter
